test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure form among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bf9859178696eaeef8b88e2bc703a49eb2a1ec5d43f5e71f1bbe2e9a852d393.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) The middle figure is rotated 90º clockwise direction in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5a5b17de4df0be8af8a18d5d26040abe6e8241acb44bb9bdf2efc379faba189.png] 

2) In the alphabet series addition of + 1 in every next figure and change their position and shifted one step next in the next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5db5dccd173e0abaa42b45946b5f132e5d58acd7bda9f8e656b9b52ec1b99a3e.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
